_comment: THE ONE HOME for the AI offers: the /start page renders from this file, the Greenfire operator's Clients tab reads it, and Pip (the Fellowship workshops agent) quotes from it. Prices, what is included and the checkout links live here and nowhere else. Checkout links are filled by `node _TOOLS/operator/offers.mjs make`, never typed by hand. No em dashes anywhere: Jordan reads them as machine written.

page.headline: Get AI working for you
page.intro: I teach artists, small businesses and teams to use AI, set you up with your own AI dashboard, or build one around how you already work. One to one or in a group, online or in person. Pick the one that fits, or tell me what you need and I will point you to the right one.
page.checkout_note: Secure checkout by Stripe. The payment page and your card statement say The Great Medicine Show, which is Jordan's own business. Your receipt comes from Stripe.

_intake_note: Our own onboarding form (api/onboard.ts, questions in api/_lib/onboardQuestions.ts), replacing the Google Form 2026-10-20. Add ?for=<offer id> to preselect the session. Answers land on the operator Clients tab.

offers.title: AI Workflow Workshop
offers.for: You want to learn how to use AI in your own work, alongside a few other people.
includes: Four hours live, five seats at most
Your own working AI setup by the end
The starter dashboard template to keep
offers.after: After you pay: a short intake form, then Jordan emails you the joining link before the day.
offers._checkout_note: Greenfire's class (2026-10-24). Run by the one shared class engine in the GMS operator (product ai-workflow-workshop, brand greenfire): after paying, buyers land on /start/thanks here, mail is signed Jordan Larsen, and it is not listed on the GMS site. The Fellowship's teaching autopilot moves this link to each new run.

offers.title: One to One Dashboard Onboarding
offers.for: You want your own AI dashboard set up with you, on your business, at your pace.
includes: Two hours one to one, screen shared
Your dashboard installed and running on your computer
Set up around your real customers, offers and week
A short written plan for what to automate next
offers.after: After you pay: pick your two hours on Jordan's calendar and fill in a short intake form.
offers._book_note: His Google Calendar booking page (made 2026-10-20): weekdays 1 to 5pm Central, 2 hour slots, 24 hours notice, one a day, his busy times blocked, Google Meet. Shown on /start/thanks after payment and sent in the welcome. Change the hours in Google Calendar, not here.

offers.title: Done For You AI Dashboard
offers.for: You want it built for you: a dashboard that runs the repeat work in your business.
includes: A 20 minute call first, so the build fits the work
One dashboard, built around your business
Up to three of your workflows connected
A two hour handover session so you can run it
Two weeks of fixes after handover
offers.terms: Half to start ($850), half at handover. Anything beyond the three workflows is quoted before it is built.
offers.after: After you pay the $850 deposit: a short intake form, and Jordan emails you within a day to book the 20 minute call.

offers.title: AI Training for Your Team
offers.unit: half day or full day, online or on site
offers.for: You run a company or organisation and want your whole team using AI well, together.
includes: A 20 minute call to learn how your team works
A session built around your team's real tasks, online or in person
Every person leaves with a working AI setup
A shared starter dashboard for the team
offers.terms: Priced by team size and length after the call. Travel is covered by the company.
offers._checkout_note: No checkout on purpose: a team is quoted after the call, then paid by invoice or a link made for that job.

private_offers.title: AI Activation: Dashboard and Agents Setup
private_offers.unit: initial setup, one to one, online
private_offers._note: Not shown on /start on purpose (the page and Pip read `offers` only). Sold by hand at half the usual $1,000, paid by invoice or a link made for the job, so mark it paid on the Clients tab. Its prep page is /activate (api/_lib/activatePage.ts): a few questions, then Claude Pro, Warp, Claude Code, GitHub, the project folder, the master prompt and the Beginners Kit link, which is set from the Clients tab.

care_plan.title: Monthly care
care_plan.about: After a build or onboarding: changes, fixes and a check in each month, so the system keeps up with your business. Optional, cancel any time, set up at handover.

audiences.label: Artist or creator
audiences.note: Musicians, makers and solo creators: the group workshop first, then one to one onboarding to set up their release, booking and posting.

audiences.label: Small business
audiences.note: Owner run businesses: one to one onboarding first, then the done for you build when they want it run for them.

audiences.label: Company or team
audiences.note: Five or more people: team training on a call and a quote, and a build for the company afterwards.

audiences.label: Just me, learning
audiences.note: People learning for themselves: the group workshop.
